bo: zla ba zhu ba de bsdus pa las byung ba'i sa bon gnyis

head: bīja
target: de yongs su gyur pa la brten pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rang bzhin gyi gri gug dang thod pa gnyis sbyor ba'i snying po la yang dag par ji lta ba bzhin yongs su shes pa'i rang bzhin gyi lha'i sa bon gnyis dang ldan pa blta bar bya'o/ / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin blta bar bya'o/ / kha dog ser zhing cher brgyan ma/ /
src_sentence: (BhrHe 164) bījadvayaṃ yathābhūtaparijñānasvabhāvaṃ paśyet. tata eva spharaṇayogena

head: sarva
target: de dag thams cad sgyu ma lta bu dang nam mkha' lta bu yongs su shes nas nyi ma gnyis dang mtshan ma dang sa bon rnams yongs su gyur pa las skyes pa'i bdag nyid he ru kar blta bar bya'o/ / zla ba dang nyi ma phyag mtshan dang sa bon yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i he ru ka'i gzugs bdag med ma dang snyoms par 'jug pa'i bdag nyid bsgom par bya'o/ / byang du dri yi sgrol ma ste/ /
src_sentence: sarvaṃ tan māyopamaṃ gaganopamaṃ ca parijñāya dvitīyaravicihnabījapariṇāmajaṃ śrīherukam ātmānaṃ paśyet.

head: spharaṇa
target: yang dag par spros pa'i sprin rnams kyis nam mkha' gang bar gyur pas/ gtso bo dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor la mchod par bya'o/ / de nas chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur mos par byas nas/ rdzas dang / blta ba dang / dge ba ma lus pa sgyu ma lta bur blta ba'i ngo bo dang / de las gzhan pa'i phyi rol gyi mchod pa khyad par can gyi bdag nyid khams gsum pa'i bdag nyid can dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i ngo bo la mchod pa dang / mchod pa po dang mchod pa'i gnas kyi dbye ba'i blo mi bya bar yang dag par mchod par bya zhing /
src_sentence: tataḥ svahṛdbījād aṣṭau pūjādevīḥ saṃsphārya tāsāṃ spharaṇameghair gaganam āpūrya sanāyakaṃ maṇḍalaṃ pūjayet. tato māyopamān sarvadharmān adhimucya  #
